infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SwiftDrop uses the camera to capture parcel condition at pickup.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SwiftDrop uses your location to provide live delivery tracking while a delivery is active.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: SwiftDrop uses your location in the background during an active delivery so the sender and receiver can follow the parcel.
